messages:
Maria G.: Heads-up — ClearWave reporting degraded inference for their dedicated pool after last night’s deploy. High p95/p99 on embeddings, errors climbing. They’ve flagged as P1 and want ETA. Need immediate owner for mitigation vs rollback. @Devin L. @Raj P. any preference?
Oncall Bot: Incident created INC-2025-112 - severity P1. Paging eng-oncall.
Devin L.: Looking now. Can you paste the error snippet and the model variant?
Maria G.: model: rw-embed-v2-quant, pool: dedicated-east-2, sample error: 
```
2025-03-14T21:03:12Z ERROR serving: kvcache miss, oom trying alloc 256MB
2025-03-14T21:03:13Z WARN runtime: fallback to cpu path, latency spike 3.2s
```
Also we're seeing increased batch queue depth. Customer says timeouts hitting production flows.
Raj P.: Thanks. My initial guess — quantized kernel regression + increased seq len from their client + a config change to batch window. If we can reduce batch window and disable prefix caching for that pool we might stop the failures. Rollback is heavier (new model artifact).
SRE Pager: Observed concurrent restarts on pool-gpu-07 since 20:58 UTC. Node OOM events align with the logs. If we reduce max_batch_tokens and toggle cache it should throttle memory use quickly.
Devin L.: I can open a hotpatch PR to change pool config and add a temporary cap: `max_batch_tokens: 1024 -> 512`, `prefix_cache: false` for dedicated-east-2. Will also attach a metric to watch. Planning PR in 10m: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/12847
Maria G.: Customer needs ETA. Suggest timeline: hotpatch deploy in 30m, observe 30m, rollback to previous model in 2h if no improvement. Who owns the hotpatch rollout and can monitor SLAs?
Raj P.: I’ll own the hotpatch rollout and the immediate health checks. @SRE Pager can you watch node restarts and p99 token latency?
SRE Pager: Watching. I’ll post alerts if restarts > 2 in 15m or p99 > 1.2s after hotpatch.
Devin L.: PR opened and CI passing. Tagging eng-runtime for quick review: @eng-runtime. Link again: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/12847 — contains config diff and a short rollback job.
Maria G.: OK team — timeline locked: hotpatch in ~30m (1729904145 UTC), monitor 30m, decision to rollback by +2h if no recovery. I’ll update customer with that plan and note we have an owner. Raj = rollout, Devin = PR + rollback job, SRE Pager = monitoring/alerts.
Raj P.: Acknowledged. I’ll start the rollout checklist and coordinate with ops to avoid concurrent deploys.
Devin L.: Will stay on review duty and stand by for rollback trigger. :thumbsup:
Maria G.: Thanks everyone. I’ll close this thread after I confirm customer updated. :white_check_mark:
